- 14 reactions | India’s leading real estate developer DLF Limited has received NCLT approval to merge 16 wholly-owned subsidiaries into the parent company. This strategic amalgamation aims to simplify the corporate structure, reduce redundant entities, cut costs, and improve operational efficiency.

DLF has been actively consolidating its subsidiaries over the past few years, including mergers completed in January 2025 and earlier amalgamations like DLF City Center, DLF Plants India, and DLF Aemo. Certain undertakings were also demerged into DLF Cyber City Developers.
